summary: Onboarding mini-lab kit: cross-border shipment, temporary badge and floor access for new infra hire
description:
Issue summary: New hire (Infra engineering) requires an on-site mini-lab kit (laptop, NVMe enclosure, 2x monitors, docking station, and test GPU dongle) shipped from the US office to London site. Request includes temporary day-pass badge provisioning and single-floor access during setup window.

Context: Candidate accepted an offer with start date 2026-03-23. Hardware is in US inventory; shipping must clear customs and arrive to London site before start date to enable first-day setup. Facilities team to provide temporary badge for two days to allow IT to configure the kit on-prem.
impact: Onboarding delay risk: if hardware and badge access are not coordinated, new hire will be unable to complete initial lab validation and network onboarding on day one. Business impact: onboarding productivity hit for infra team; scheduling cost for cross-time-zone IT staff.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Request originated via recruiting -> People Ops -> Facilities on 2026-03-12
2) Shipping ticket placed with US logistics on 2026-03-13 (awaiting export paperwork and courier pickup)
3) Facilities needs to provision temporary badge and floor access for 2026-03-23; requires headcount/HR confirmation and badge pickup slot
4) IT requires access to unlock lab cabinet and power rack on arrival for initial hardware burn-in
investigation_notes: 2026-03-13 09:15 - Lena: Confirmed kit contents available in SFO inventory (SKU KIT-MINI-01). Need export declaration number from US logistics.
2026-03-13 14:40 - Logistics: DHL quoted 4-6 business days with commercial invoice; expedited available but additional cost requires approval from People Ops.
2026-03-13 16:10 - Facilities: London site badge provisioning requires completed new-hire HR form and photo; temporary day-pass can be created same-day at security desk once confirmation is received.
2026-03-14 08:55 - Customs risk: NVMe enclosure with drive flagged for additional inspection by UK customs; recommended to include ATA carnet or detailed contents to avoid hold.
Hypothesis: Hold probability ~25% due to drive-containing media; mitigations include ATA carnet, image-only drives, or courier priority handling.
comments: Miguel Ortega (Reporter) 2026-03-13: Created ticket after People Ops asked for hardwaren shipment and badge pick up. Please advise on fastest option to guarantee 2026-03-23 delivery.

Lena Chen (Assignee) 2026-03-13: Reached out to US logistics for export docs and to DHL account rep for customs clearance options. Will request ATA carnet quote. Booking blocked pending People Ops approval for expedited fees.
Sophie Martin (People Ops) 2026-03-13: Approving expedited shipping fees if ETA < 2026-03-20. Please supply cost estimate and courier tracking once dispatched.

Facilities Security (London) 2026-03-14: Can issue 48-hour temporary badge on arrival with HR confirmation email. Recommend scheduling badge pickup between 09:00-10:00 on 2026-03-23 to align with IT setup slot.
IT Onboarding (Tom Baker) 2026-03-14: Need explicit cabinet key access added to temporary badge and reserved bench in lab 2B for initial burn-in. Please confirm rack number and downtime window.
Lena Chen 2026-03-14: Booked courier pickup for 2026-03-15 pending ATA carnet; requested expedited clearance. Added linked issue INT-16205 for workstation kitting coordination.
resolution_summary: (Pending) Workaround and plan in progress: Logistics to request ATA carnet and use DHL priority with customs brokerage to minimize hold risk; People Ops approved expedited fee if ETA meets target. Facilities confirmed temporary 48-hour badge and bench reservation once HR provides confirmation email. Next steps: confirm ATA carnet by 2026-03-15, dispatch by 2026-03-15, share tracking. Close ticket after delivery confirmation and badge provisioning verified.
next_steps: 1) Logistics to submit ATA carnet request and provide cost estimate by 2026-03-15
2) People Ops to send HR confirmation email to facilities (required for badge) by 2026-03-15
3) If ATA carnet cannot be secured, switch to courier-priority with full customs brokerage and accept 24-48h hold risk; approve additional fee
4) Lena to update ticket with tracking number and expected delivery ETA; Facilities to schedule badge pickup and bench reservation upon receipt of tracking and HR confirmation
